This indicates that the comment is addressing a specific part of the paper related to the selection of baselines. The comment explicitly states that GNN-QE is "completely omitted from the baselines," and baselines are a standard, identifiable component of a scientific paper, so the authors can clearly know which part (the baselines section/comparison) is being addressed. The comment also specifies what needs to be addressed: this baseline should be added and compared. Therefore, the comment explicitly identifies the relevant part of the paper (the baselines) and clearly specifies what needs to be done there.
